question: Can final Horn-closure supervision together with asynchronous soundness and fact-preservation constraints improve depth-4/5 subgoal inference over equal-forward-call final-only relay supervision?

ownership.previous_science: AF12 synchronous-wave supervision failed on eligible local seed17 and hosted full run was blocked before runner allocation

source.cell: Exact source-hash-pinned AF-05 GraphLooper and original TypedLoop, 29 tokens with two float32 carried coordinates each
source.qualification: Both source warmups scored 1.0 train/dev goal and joint Q before any AF13 training

data.train: Original AF05 train: 672 inputs at depth2/3 layouts 0/1/2; fit only
data.dev: Original AF05 dev: 224 inputs at depth2/3 layout 3; eligibility only
data.novelty_scope: Unused physical permutations; underlying Boolean Horn templates held fixed. Input feature hashes disjoint from AF05, AF11 and AF12 scored cases.
data.features: Only initial facts and public rule/role/incidence enter student; least-closure status, intermediate eligibility, and donor oracle remain host-owned targets.

architecture.source_native_cell: Original unchanged hash-pinned TypedLoop (via AF05 GraphLooper)
architecture.cut: AF10 exact structural Q-code latch for downstream goal; unchanged across arms

training.runtime_target: Python3.12 Torch2.5.1+cpu NumPy>=1.24,<3; local alternative runtime reported separately
training.per_update: 16 depth2 + 16 depth3 recipient/donor examples; identical sampler RNG and source initialization across arms
training.clock: For a fixed optimizer update index, each depth has the same original 2*depth or 2*depth+2 upstream recurrent-cell visits in every arm; alternate +2 on odd updates; extra traced prefixes are run by all arms.
training.common_loss: AF12 original Q/goal clean, addressed donor and irrelevant-patch CE; original baseline prefix always uses 2*depth native calls
training.terminal: common_loss only; same extra trace forward calls
training.relay_final: common_loss +0.35 weighted terminal-closure atom CE at jittered traced horizon; does not supervise exact arrival wave
training.async_sound: relay_final +0.08 initial-fact CE at all stages +0.08 unreachable-atom CE at all stages +0.10 monotonicity-probability decrease squared +0.06 one-step soft rule-support violation squared
training.support: Only logical upstream rules: p_t(v) <= max_{r->v} product_{u in prem(r)} p_(t-1)(u) for every nonfact atom. Fact preservation and unreachable support use the exact Horn oracle. This is a differentiable surrogate, not a claim of discrete Boolean proof correctness per step.
training.checkpoint_selection: Final update exactly; fixed optimizer budget, no heldout hyperparameter tuning; all arms and failed seeds retained
training.cost_caveat: Actual source recurrent-cell forward calls and updates matched, auxiliary loss/backward FLOPs differ by arm

math.operator: Phi(S) = S union {h | (P=>h) in R and P subset S}
math.asynchronous_update: S[t+1] = S[t] union E[t], where E[t] subset of heads enabled in S[t]
math.soundness: Every valid asynchronous prefix S[t] is contained in the least fixed point L. A persistent enabled-rule fairness assumption yields eventual L on finite atoms; without a bounded delay assumption no uniform convergence deadline follows.
math.training_targets: Only initial facts, atoms outside final least closure, endpoint final closure, monotone/soft support conditions; no prescribed discrete S[t] wave labels
math.lean_scope: Lean 4.19.0 compiles elementary Boolean Horn isotonicity, addition and premise lemmas; general finite-fairness proof given separately as mathematical induction, not Lean-certified
math.negative_controls: Other-subgoal intervention and clean goal; check changing graph and clocks without changing logical identity

evaluation.eligibility: Both relay_final and async_sound arms must each have >=.90 original train AND dev goal and exact joint-Q accuracy, seed by seed
evaluation.primary_gate: For every eligible seed at BOTH depths: async_sound - relay_final joint-Q exact >=.05 and final all-atom accuracy >=.05; extended +2 recurrence Q accuracy >= relay_final -0.03; clean goal and informative patch accuracy no worse by >.03; no additional false goal attempts; irrelevant patch goal retention >=.90. Ineligible strata remain inconclusive; any eligible failure makes aggregate fail; all seeds eligible and pass makes pass.
evaluation.diagnostics: Track start-fact loss, unreachable false positives, monotonicity violations, full-trajectory admissibility, final atom accuracy and extra-horizon Q and goal accuracy, separately from causal-cut intervention metrics
evaluation.independent_audit: Recompute each source Horn closure, original donor targets and stage-wise admissibility from saved raw logits; verify source hashes, all checkpoint exports, both horizons and sampled donor forward replay
evaluation.certification: Lean checks Boolean primitives and closed synthetic Horn theorems; not neural proof search or arbitrary Lean theorem discovery

failure_policy: Engineering integrity and scientific verdict separate. Preserve eligible failures and all seed/arm outcomes, original AF01..12 evidence unchanged. Scientific modifications require another registration.
